Privacy / a short note

Clear enough
to trust.

This page is a starting point for the final notice. Confirm the actual vendors, retention period, jurisdiction, and consent requirements before launch.

What this site collects

The contact form asks for your name, email address, what you need help with, and a short brief. Company website, budget range, and timing are optional.

Why it is used

The information is used to understand and respond to an enquiry. It should not be used for unrelated marketing unless a separate lawful basis and consent are in place.

What not to send

Please do not include private customer information, account credentials, confidential campaign data, or anything you would not want included in an ordinary business email.

Before launch

Connect the enquiry endpoint to an approved notification or email service, define a retention period, review any third-party processing, and replace this starter notice with advice appropriate to the actual business and target markets.
